description: Search permanent public offices and their sourced holders by official name, office title, or jurisdiction. Federal, state, executive and selected local coverage is included; local coverage is incomplete and source verification dates must be retained. Not an address-to-representative lookup. A missing holder is not proof of a vacancy.

level.description: State includes legislative and executive offices.

state.description: Two-letter state or territory code of the public records being researched, not the user's location.

name: search_offices
title: Find public offices and recorded officeholders
